name: Path of the Totem Warrior
description: A barbarian who forges a spiritual bond with animal totems, gaining their gifts while raging.
note: 6th-level (Aspect of the Beast) and 14th-level (Totemic Attunement) are each a fresh animal choice using the SAME feature name at every tier — see option_catalog below rather than features_by_level, since these are 'choose one of N options' picks, not a single fixed feature grant like most subclasses. A real character has exactly one Totem Spirit, one Aspect of the Beast, and one Totemic Attunement choice (each independently chosen, can repeat or vary the animal).
